carrier_denial_notice: CLAIM DENIED ($0 PAYOUT): Missed Heathrow connection to Paris caused by Air Traffic Control sequencing at JFK (Code ATC-14).
passenger_statement: My ticket had a 77-minute layover at Heathrow, way above the 45-minute minimum. At JFK the captain announced they were still loading catering carts for 40 minutes, and I missed my Paris flight by just 9 minutes, arriving 4 hours 8 minutes late with $65 in terminal meal receipts.
